questions.question_english: Which type of fire extinguisher is most appropriate for a school computer laboratory where fires may involve live electrical equipment?

Aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) mechanical type extinguisher
Carbon Dioxide (CO2) or Clean Agent extinguisher
Wet Chemical extinguisher
questions.explanation_english: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) or Clean Agent extinguisher Carbon Dioxide and Clean Agent extinguishers are specifically designed to extinguish Class C electrical fires without conducting electricity or damaging sensitive electronic components. Water or foam-based extinguishing media present severe electrocution risks and destroy electronic systems. Deploying non-conductive suppression agents in computer laboratories ensures rapid fire suppression while safeguarding human operators and technical equipment assets.

questions.explanation_english: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation CPR stands for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation, an emergency medical procedure combining chest compressions and artificial ventilation. questions.question_english: In school safety management, the concept of the “Whole School Approach” refers to which of the following?
options_english: Involving only the senior secondary students in formulating safety rules
Restricting safety management to the physical infrastructure of the school building
Delegating all safety compliance tasks to an external private security agency

questions.explanation_english: Engaging all stakeholders including management, teachers, staff, parents, and students in safety planning and execution The Whole School Approach to safety emphasizes active participation and collaboration among all institutional stakeholders. questions.question_english: Which statutory body monitors the protection and implementation of child rights and may investigate child-safety violations in schools?
options_english: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)
Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR)
National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)
questions.explanation_english: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) The National Commission for Protection of Child Rights is the statutory body established under the CPCR Act, 2005, to monitor child rights enforcement nationwide. It evaluates legal safeguards, inspects educational facilities, investigates child safety violations, and issues statutory recommendations. Statutory oversight ensures that child safety guidelines, legislative mandates, and welfare policies are systematically implemented across all schools.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: राष्ट्रीय बाल अधिकार संरक्षण आयोग (NCPCR)। यह उपाय बाल अधिकारों की रक्षा, सुरक्षित शिकायत-प्रक्रिया और बच्चों से संबंधित मामलों में संवेदनशील तथा नियमसम्मत कार्रवाई सुनिश्चित करने में मदद करता है।

questions.question_english: Which statement about a school’s legal liability for safety breaches is incorrect?
options_english: Schools are immune from legal action if a safety breach occurs despite having a policy
Schools remain accountable for negligence and failures to implement safety measures
Safety duties and emergency contacts should be documented and communicated
The school must take corrective action when student safety is compromised
questions.explanation_english: Schools are immune from legal action if a safety breach occurs despite policy implementation. Policy adoption does not grant institutions immunity from legal liabilities when safety breaches or negligence occur. Accountability framework standards require transparent responsibility across all staff categories, mandatory public displays of child protection contact details, and clearly documented emergency duties. Schools remain legally accountable for maintaining active vigilance, proper enforcement, and quick corrective action whenever student safety is compromised.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है: यदि सुरक्षा नीति मौजूद हो, तो सुरक्षा में चूक के बावजूद विद्यालय कानूनी कार्रवाई से मुक्त है। इस उपाय से पहचाने गए जोखिमों को कम करने, आपात स्थिति के लिए तैयारी बढ़ाने और विद्यार्थियों तथा कर्मचारियों की सुरक्षित निकासी/सुरक्षा में मदद मिलती है।

questions.question_english: During an earthquake, if students are in a classroom, where is the safest place for them to take cover?
options_english: Under a sturdy desk or table away from falling objects
Near large glass windows and exterior brick walls to look outside
Next to tall, unsecured bookshelves
In the center of the room standing upright
questions.explanation_english: Under a sturdy desk or table away from falling objects Taking cover beneath heavy, sturdy desks or tables provides essential physical shelter against falling ceiling plaster, light fixtures, and structural debris during earthquakes. Students must position themselves away from glass windows, exterior walls, and unsecured tall storage units. Sturdy furniture shelters absorb impact energy, protecting occupants from direct head trauma and crushing injuries during shaking.
